entries.title: Safety contract comments and SAFETY_ARCHITECTURE.md state behaviour the code does not have: 'Halt All Trading' claimed to cancel open orders (it only blocks new ones), wrong trigger exception type, wrong file pointers, a removed toolbar fallback
entries.repro: Read types/safety.ts:41-46 ('Adapters cancel all open orders, set readOnly = true') then sidecar/services/broker_base.py:433-441 (base _on_kill_switch explicitly does NOT cancel; no subclass overrides it). Run a DELETE against audit_orders -> sqlite3.IntegrityError, while sidecar/services/audit_log.py:12-15 documents sqlite3.OperationalError. types/safety.ts:17-18,76-78 point at services/audit_log.py for triggers that live in sidecar/models/audit_log.py:40-50. kill_switch.rs:46-48,69-71,77-78 log 'toolbar button still works' for a toolbar that no longer exists.
entries.evidence: types/safety.ts:17-18,41-46,76-78; sidecar/services/broker_base.py:103,251,345,433-441; sidecar/services/audit_log.py:12-15; sidecar/models/audit_log.py:40-50; src-tauri/src/kill_switch.rs:46-48,69-71,77-78; docs/SAFETY_ARCHITECTURE.md:118,243. Refuter admitted, medium; refuter scope note: the kill switch gates ONLY broker order placement, so the mechanism's future is tied to the 23 Sep trading-removal scope change.
entries.root_cause: Comments written against the original §6.5 design (cancel-all, OperationalError, KillSwitchToolbar fallback) and never updated when the implementation narrowed and the toolbar was removed.
entries.fix_shape: Text-only: state 'blocks new orders; open orders are NOT cancelled', correct the exception type to IntegrityError, fix the file pointers to sidecar/models/audit_log.py, delete the toolbar-fallback sentences in kill_switch.rs and SAFETY_ARCHITECTURE.md. If the trading removal retires the kill switch, delete the comments with it instead. Pin: a test asserting the append-only trigger raises sqlite3.IntegrityError (already implied by CLAUDE.md) keeps the doc honest.

entries.title: COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md and LICENSING.md give commercial@vysted.com as the only commercial contact, but vysted.com has no MX or A record, so a would-be licensee under PolyForm Strict has no working way to buy a license
entries.repro: Read the PolyForm Strict notice (no commercial use), open COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md:63 -> contact commercial@vysted.com '(placeholder address'; DNS lookup for vysted.com MX -> none, A -> none (Cloudflare nameservers only). Mail to the address cannot be delivered.
entries.evidence: COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md:3,50,59,63; LICENSING.md (same contact); refuter admitted_with_correction, medium: TBD pricing is what BLUEPRINT §6.1 specifies until v1.0, so the live defect is the undeliverable contact, not the TBD prices.
entries.root_cause: Placeholder contact kept through the D83 relicense; the domain was never given mail routing.
entries.fix_shape: Operator: set up a real inbox (MX on vysted.com or another owned address) and replace the placeholder in COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md and LICENSING.md before any public 0.9.0 announcement; pricing may stay TBD per §6.1. Pin: a release-checklist line checking the contact domain resolves MX.

entries.title: BLUEPRINT §2 Locked Decisions and CLAUDE.md (project DNA) name Next.js 16 App Router static export as the frontend stack; the repo has no Next.js and ships Vite 8 + React 19 (D6)
entries.repro: grep '"next"' package.json -> no match; package.json scripts dev='vite', build='vite build', vite ^8.0.16; no next.config.*; vite.config.ts + index.html at repo root. Yet docs/BLUEPRINT.md:52 (Locked table) and :90,108,232,442 say Next.js, and CLAUDE.md:5,28,38,222 say 'Next.js 16 (App Router, static export)' with a static-export SSR rationale.
entries.evidence: package.json:8,82; docs/BLUEPRINT.md:52,90,108,232,442; CLAUDE.md:5,28,38,222; docs/redesign/DECISIONS.md:28 (D6 authorized the Vite migration); docs/redesign/CLAUDE_MD_PROPOSAL.md:5-6 (pending correction). Refuters admitted both at medium. Refuter extra: CLAUDE.md:57 still lists 'AGPL-3.0 + commercial dual license' as Locked while the core is PolyForm Strict after 0c63d46 (BLUEPRINT.md:58 is already corrected).
entries.root_cause: D6 migrated the bundler but only the license line of the Locked table got an in-place correction; CLAUDE.md is Tier-1 and its correction sits unlanded in CLAUDE_MD_PROPOSAL.md.
